About Us

Five sets of hands, one workshop.

Mitti Studio started in a small room with wet paint, dried clay dust, and too many half-finished canvases. Sujal — trained in painting and drawing — began taking on commissions for neighbours and friends, and slowly gathered four other artists who shared the same instinct: make it by hand, or don't make it at all.

Today the studio holds painters, sketch artists, a sculptor, and a maker of everyday handmade objects, all working out of the same space. Nothing here is mass-produced. Every brushstroke, carved edge and clay curve carries the mark of the person who made it.

"Mitti" means earth — because everything we make starts there.

Custom Orders

Commission something made for you

Tell us what you're picturing — a portrait, a wall piece, a murti for your home, or something entirely your own. We'll get back to you with ideas, timelines and pricing.

  • i. Share your idea, reference photos or rough sketch
  • ii. We propose a concept, size and price
  • iii. Your piece is handcrafted and shipped with care

We typically reply within 2–3 days with a concept and quote.

Our Process

From idea to something you can hold

i.

Idea

We talk through what you want — the feeling, the space it's for, the story behind it.

ii.

Design

A concept sketch or colour study comes back to you before anything is made.

iii.

Handcraft

The chosen artist paints, draws, sculpts or builds your piece entirely by hand.

iv.

Delivery

Packed with care and delivered to your door, ready to hang or display.
